notes: Changeovers switch (Teams / Taplin) on the Race screen for the timing desk and the Starter: off unless turned on, off again at power-up and for a new event

Changeovers on: a press lights the lane 1 s, off 2 s, then on until the next driver presses (up to 10 s). A press before the go light that's followed by more racing shows as 'early tag-out?' for the judges (DQ / It's fine)
The event is worked out from the presses (single, Mass, Teams, IRB Relay); leg names and changeover times in results and the spreadsheet
